LLM RL typically operates in one of three exploration regimes: sharpening, chaining, or guided exploration; standard RL stays in the first two and plateaus on hard problems, even those in the training set. Mixing easy and hard data triggers interference, causing reward-rich tasks to drown out hard ones and stall exploration. Our approach (POPE) pushes RL into the guided regime by conditioning on prefixes from offline human data while keeping updates fully on-policy. This lets RL reliably find reward on problems previously unsolved without falling prey to the optimization issues suffered by methods that directly supervise offline traces.
